faq.q: How much does The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov charge?
faq.a: The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov have offices?
faq.a: The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov publishes one office, in Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov?
faq.a: The Law Office of Anthony Sharnov names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
